content.title: Hazard Gauntlet Variant | Three-Way Countdown and Larger False-Safety Threat
content.summary: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis. Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography. Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space. Use one large moving occluder to create a plausible but temporary safety assumption. Clear the occluder and reveal the retained threat at a larger or closer scale in relation to the same adult.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis. + Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography. + Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space. + Use one large moving occluder to create a plausible but temporary safety assumption. + Clear the occluder and reveal the retained threat at a larger or closer scale in relation to the same adult.
quick_start.recommended_input: On an original stormy mountain service road, establish one clearly adult snowplow driver in an orange cab fleeing a rolling black ice mass on the same downhill axis. The adult accelerates across the first rail while the ice mass closes from behind and the tram closes from the side; show three distance gaps shrinking without arbitrary cuts. When the last carriage clears, reveal the retained ice mass towering above the depot roof and sliding toward the stopped truck; hold the same adult visible in the cab before impact.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis. Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography. Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space. Use one large moving occluder to create a plausible but temporary safety assumption. Clear the occluder and reveal the retained threat at a larger or closer scale in relation to the same adult. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one clearly adult original subject, one pursuing threat and a readable escape axis.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Add a second physical hazard from a different direction without abandoning the shared geography.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Make both hazards converge through visible distance or time reduction while the subject acts within the same space.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Use one large moving occluder to create a plausible but temporary safety assumption.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Clear the occluder and reveal the retained threat at a larger or closer scale in relation to the same adult.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.

slots.name: lead_subject

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source man, face, black shirt, wounds and jeep
source crocodile-dinosaur design and exact scale
source jungle road, railway crossing, train and weather
source exact pursuit, crossing, occlusion, reveal and timing
source creator identity, Seedance 2.0 claim, platform marks and prompt wording
